title: Elementary Mathematics Education
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Display increasing confidence in their ability to use a range of speaking, listening and collaboration skills
Explain fundamental mathematical concepts—including number systems, operations, algebra, geometry and probability—in a way that supports conceptual understanding for elementary learners
Design and relate messages clearly for effective and appropriate oral communication
Apply problem-solving strategies and mathematical reasoning to real-world scenarios relevant to elementary education and everyday decision-making

Analyze, evaluate and respond competently to discourse by weighing research, examining evidence and using critical reasoning; use visual models, manipulatives and representations to support mathematical thinking and communication, particularly in the context of elementary math instruction
Demonstrate fluency with key topics from finite mathematics and liberal arts math, including logic, set theory, combinatorics and basic financial mathematics
Interpret and analyze data using basic statistical techniques relevant to classroom assessment and educational research
Communicate mathematical ideas clearly and accurately using appropriate language, notation and pedagogical techniques for diverse learners
careers: mathematics education at the elementary level
